  "page_id": "zed-industries/zed/README.md",

  "units": [
    {"ordinal":0,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Page title."},
    {"ordinal":1,"function":"promotion","proposition":"Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.","support":"Links to https://github.com/atom/atom and https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter; no performance measurements, multiplayer examples, or creator attribution evidence supplied."},
    {"ordinal":2,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Installation section heading."},
    {"ordinal":3,"function":"capability","proposition":"Zed can be downloaded directly or installed through local package managers on macOS, Linux, and Windows.","support":"https://zed.dev/download; platform instructions at https://zed.dev/docs/installation#macos, https://zed.dev/docs/linux#installing-via-a-package-manager, and https://zed.dev/docs/windows#package-managers."},
    {"ordinal":4,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Other platforms are not yet available.","support":"The following list identifies Web and links tracking discussion 26195."},
    {"ordinal":5,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Web is a platform not yet available.","support":"Preceding unavailability statement; https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/discussions/26195."},
    {"ordinal":6,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Developing Zed section heading."},
    {"ordinal":7,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Build guide link: ./docs/src/development/macos.md."},
    {"ordinal":8,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Build guide link: ./docs/src/development/linux.md."},
    {"ordinal":9,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Build guide link: ./docs/src/development/windows.md."},
    {"ordinal":10,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Contributing section heading."},
    {"ordinal":11,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Consult CONTRIBUTING.md for ways to contribute to Zed.","support":"Link to ./CONTRIBUTING.md."},
    {"ordinal":12,"function":"promotion","proposition":"The Zed team is hiring.","support":"The following sentence links https://zed.dev/jobs for open roles."},
    {"ordinal":13,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Visit the jobs page for open roles.","support":"https://zed.dev/jobs; preceding hiring announcement."},
    {"ordinal":14,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Licensing section heading."},
    {"ordinal":15,"function":"definition","proposition":"Zed source code is primarily GPL-3.0-or-later, with Apache-2.0 components where marked.","support":"Qualified by 'primarily' and 'where marked'; no license files or marked components supplied."},
    {"ordinal":16,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Correct license information for third-party dependencies is required for CI to pass.","support":"Following cargo-about troubleshooting instructions describe missing license information and unsatisfied license requirements."},
    {"ordinal":17,"function":"other","proposition":"","support":"Incomplete lead-in to the protected cargo-about reference on line 36."},
    {"ordinal":18,"function":"capability","proposition":"The stated purpose is automatic open source license compliance; if CI fails, check the following items.","support":"Line 36 names cargo-about and links https://github.com/EmbarkStudios/cargo-about; subsequent instructions require manual checks and possible legal advice."},
    {"ordinal":19,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Diagnostic question fragment preceding protected `no license specified` on line 38."},
    {"ordinal":20,"function":"instruction","proposition":"If a crate you created has the specified error, add the indicated configuration.","support":"Line 38 specifies `no license specified` and adding `publish = false` under `[package]` in the crate's Cargo.toml."},
    {"ordinal":21,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Placement connector between protected `publish = false` and `[package]` on line 38."},
    {"ordinal":22,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Make the indicated addition in your crate's Cargo.toml.","support":"Line 38 conditions the addition of `publish = false` under `[package]` on a `no license specified` error for a crate you created."},
    {"ordinal":23,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Diagnostic question fragment preceding protected `failed to satisfy license requirements` on line 39."},
    {"ordinal":24,"function":"instruction","proposition":"For the specified dependency error, determine the project's license and whether this system meets its requirements; ask a lawyer if unsure, and add the license's SPDX identifier only after verifying acceptability.","support":"Line 39 specifies `failed to satisfy license requirements` and the destination `accepted` array in `script/licenses/zed-licenses.toml`."},
    {"ordinal":25,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Destination connector between protected `accepted` and `script/licenses/zed-licenses.toml` on line 39."},
    {"ordinal":26,"function":"instruction","proposition":"","support":"Diagnostic question fragment preceding protected `cargo-about` on line 40."},
    {"ordinal":27,"function":"instruction","proposition":"If the tool cannot find a dependency's license, add a clarification field at the end of the indicated configuration file.","support":"Line 40 identifies `cargo-about`, `script/licenses/zed-licenses.toml`, and the linked cargo-about book's crate configuration instructions."},
    {"ordinal":28,"function":"instruction","proposition":"Follow the cargo-about book's specification for the clarification field.","support":"https://embarkstudios.github.io/cargo-about/cli/generate/config.html#crate-configuration; preceding instruction applies when cargo-about cannot find a dependency's license."},
    {"ordinal":29,"function":"transition","proposition":"","support":"Sponsorship section heading."},
    {"ordinal":30,"function":"definition","proposition":"Zed is developed by Zed Industries, Inc., a for-profit company.","support":"absent"},
    {"ordinal":31,"function":"capability","proposition":"Readers wishing to financially support the project can use GitHub Sponsors.","support":"Following sentences specify that funds become Zed Industries' general revenue and provide no perks or entitlements."},
    {"ordinal":32,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Sponsorship funds go directly to Zed Industries as general company revenue.","support":"The section identifies Zed Industries, Inc. as a for-profit company; no financial evidence supplied."},
    {"ordinal":33,"function":"qualification","proposition":"Sponsorship provides no perks or entitlements.","support":"absent"}
  ]
}
